notes: Carpet accounts check for new rallies once a minute instead of every few seconds. The short troop mix is accepted (659 means 6 5 9, e.g. !fill name 659 60), and resource requests to the bank are written as 6M / 500K. Each account keeps a short record of what the game last said about gifts, the Colosseum, shields and training. A failed update now says what stopped it.
